title: S.R.&O. 7 of 2026 Caricom Arrest Warrant Act (Commencement) Order
text:
A 101
2026 CARICOM Arrest Warrant Act SRO. 7
(Commencement) Order
GRENADA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS NO. 7 OF 2026
The Minister in exercise of the powers conferred on him pursuant to section
1 of the CARICOM Arrest Warrant Act No. 4 of 2026, hereby makes the
following Order–
(Gazetted 22nd May, 2026).
1. Citation. This Order may cited as the
CARICOM ARREST WARRANT ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER, 2026.
2. Commencement. The CARICOM Arrest Warrant Act, No. 4 of 2026 shall come
into force on the 1st day of June, 2026.
Made by the Minister this 15th day of May, 2026.
DICKON MITCHELL
Minister responsible for National Security.
GRENADA
PRINTED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, AT THE GOVERNMENT
PRINTING OFFICE, ST. GEORGE’S
22/5/2026.
